severity.blocker: Primary task, safety, permissions, content access or material accessibility is broken.
severity.major: System, responsive, state or hierarchy violation materially reduces usability or consistency.
severity.minor: Localized polish, content or optical issue with a clear correction.

gates.rule: Use installed UI-kit components when an equivalent exists.
gates.fix: replace imitation with installed primitive

gates.rule: Use installed semantic tokens or values derived from them.
gates.fix: map literals and arbitrary values to semantic roles

gates.rule: Use the installed icon, type, radius and shadow systems consistently.
gates.fix: remove parallel visual language

gates.rule: Declare wide, medium and narrow transformations.
gates.fix: define content-driven transformations

gates.rule: Preserve required content and action without ordinary page overflow at 320 CSS px.
gates.evidence: 320 CSS px or equivalent zoom capture
gates.fix: reflow, collapse auxiliary regions, or isolate justified two-dimensional scroll

gates.rule: Share title, toolbar, content and footer alignment lines.
gates.fix: use one page inset and grid owner

gates.rule: Use the installed 4 px spacing scale and the 8 px primary rhythm.
gates.fix: replace one-off gaps with scale values

gates.rule: Repeated components share anatomy, baselines and density.
gates.fix: use shared component composition and variants

gates.rule: Meet WCAG 2.2 AA text and non-text contrast for required UI.
gates.fix: change semantic foreground, background or boundary tokens

gates.rule: Do not use color as the only state or data cue.
gates.fix: add text, shape, icon, label or pattern

gates.rule: Keep selection, status, severity and type visually distinct.
gates.fix: reduce competing fills and assign semantic roles

gates.rule: Use one product link/action token and one chart palette per metric family.
gates.fix: replace local colors with shared semantic tokens

gates.rule: Essential content and actions use readable installed typography roles.
gates.fix: restore type role and allow wrapping

gates.rule: Remove subtitles and helper copy that repeat visible structure.
gates.fix: retain only consequence, provenance or recovery copy

gates.rule: Actions have specific outcome-oriented labels.
gates.fix: replace ambiguous labels

gates.rule: All required actions are keyboard operable with visible focus.
gates.fix: use semantic or UI-kit control and APG behavior

gates.rule: Composite components follow installed or APG keyboard and focus conventions.
gates.fix: implement the matching component pattern

gates.rule: Selection, focus, hover and semantic status remain distinguishable in combination.
gates.fix: separate surface, outline and status cues

gates.rule: Errors have scope, consequence and a valid recovery path.
gates.fix: preserve trustworthy context and add safe recovery

gates.rule: Implement applicable loading, empty, partial, stale, restricted, pending and success states.
gates.fix: implement missing applicable states

gates.rule: Consequential actions show pending, success and failure feedback without duplicate execution.
gates.fix: add observable operation state and recovery

gates.rule: Controls have correct semantics, accessible names and associated field errors.
gates.fix: use native/UI-kit semantics and associations

gates.rule: Targets meet 24 by 24 CSS px minimum or spacing exception; primary touch controls use product touch size.
gates.fix: enlarge visual or hit target and preserve spacing

gates.rule: Focused content is not obscured by sticky, floating or overlay UI.
gates.fix: reposition, dismiss or convert fixed content

gates.rule: Motion has a functional purpose and reduced-motion behavior.
gates.fix: use motion tokens and immediate/opacity substitute

gates.rule: Routine transitions use consistent duration, easing and compositor-friendly properties.
gates.fix: map to motion tokens and opacity/transform

gates.rule: Metrics and trends expose unit, timeframe, basis and evidence or drill-down.
gates.fix: add the missing basis or remove the metric

gates.rule: Tables keep sorting in headers and pagination in footers when results are partial.
gates.fix: move controls to standard table regions

gates.rule: Charts have accessible labels or alternatives and do not rely on color alone.
gates.fix: add annotations, legend semantics and a textual/table alternative
